## Details

### `show qos cosq-stats interface [<ports>]`

Drops in one queue mean that traffic class runs out of buffer. Reset with `clear qos cosq-stats interface <ports>` and watch whether they still increase.


### `show qos cosq-stats cpu-port`

Pair it with `show khi cpp port-statistics` to see which port and packet type sends the load.


### `show filter acl statistics [<acl-id>] [all]`

If a counter stays at 0, check the ACL is attached to the port or VLAN and the ACE is enabled. Counting can be switched off per ACE (an EDM option since 9.2). Show the filter itself with `show filter acl config [<acl-id>]`.


### `show sflow / show sflow statistics`

Per-port sampling is set with `sflow sampling-rate` in Interface Config.


### `show ip ipfix flows`

Since 9.4 IPFIX can be enabled per UNI port or on all NNIs (`ip ipfix port <ports> enable`, `ip ipfix nni enable`).
